definition.description: Judge whether disclosed orders are binding, economically material, timed, and likely to convert to revenue.

signals.skill: Separate binding purchase orders and funded backlog from MOUs, framework agreements, maximum-ceiling awards, and non-binding pipeline. Evaluate amount, customer commitment, delivery timing, cancellation rights, and revenue conversion. Cite literal spans.
